text: B J C Health referral automation. From email inbox to Genie, with zero manual handling.
Processing hundreds of referral letters each month takes hours of staff time. Reading each P D F, entering patient details, filing to the right doctor. It all adds up.
Here's how the automation changes that.
Referral emails arrive in a dedicated mailbox. Every fifteen minutes, the system picks up each new P D F attachment automatically.
A I reads the letter and extracts the patient's name, date of birth, Medicare number, the referring doctor, and which B J C Health doctor should receive it.
A Genie-compatible H L 7 file is created with patient details and the original P D F attached. It's saved directly to the Genie import folder on the server.
Processed emails move to the Linked folder automatically. If the system can't read a letter, it goes to Review, and staff receive a notification.
No patient documents are stored in the cloud. Everything is processed in memory, in Australian data centres, and discarded immediately after conversion.
Built by SMECK A I for B J C Health.
